map.自定义密码长度并勾选大小写、数字、符号等字符类型，生成高强度随机密码，同时实时评: Customize the password length and tick character types such as upper and lower case, digits and symbols to generate a high-strength random password, while assessing its strength in real time, with one-click copy for account registration or key setup.
map.强度分 = 长度 × 4 + 字符种类 × 10（≥12 位 +10、≥16 位: Strength score = length x 4 + character types x 10 (>=12 characters +10, >=16 characters +15, all four types +15)
map.字符种类统计小写/大写/数字/符号四类中出现的种数。并设上限修正：长度 <8 位: Character types count how many of the four categories lower case / upper case / digits / symbols appear. Upper-limit corrections also apply: length <8 caps the score at 30, <6 caps it at 15, and containing only one character type caps it at 25. Scores are banded: <30 weak, <55 medium, <80 strong, otherwise very strong. The character pool is decided by the ticked options, and similar characters 0O1lI and ambiguous characters can be further excluded.
map.为不同网站生成互不相同的高强度口令，规避一处泄露牵连全部。: Generate a distinct high-strength password for each website so that a leak at one does not compromise them all.
